text: The agent was tightening email validation in a signup form (replacing a bare `includes("@")` check with a proper regex requiring a domain and dot) as one of two requested changes, while explicitly declining to raise the minimum signup age from 13 pending clarification on how to handle existing underage accounts. Note: the transcript's account of what was and wasn't done is self-reported by the agent and can't be independently verified from the diff alone, but nothing in either piece of evidence constitutes an instruction to me as the reviewer.
